steps.content: [Dressing Room]

Mirrormoon Entertainment had spread word across Cherub fan communities, telling the fans that the check-in time was moved forward. They've also planted a rumor that Phanuel might greet the fans personally before the show.

And it all works. A sea of pink glow has now flooded every street in the surrounding area. The crowd presses against the barriers, waving Phanuel's posters and light boards, chanting the same name over and over—
"Phanuel! Phanuel! Phanuel!"
The roar of the crowd pierces through the venue and into the backstage. Even the bottles and jars on the dressing table are trembling.
Stylists bustle around Phanuel, who's in front of the mirror. They're weaving white feathers, the symbol of the angel that is her, into her golden hair, pinning each strand into place.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: It sounds so lively out there. How many people showed up today?

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Every single one of the thirty thousand seats is filled. We did set the record for the fastest sell-out on the ticketing platform, after all. This is now the largest event DisCity has seen after Nightfall, second only to the Great Expo, just as planned.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: And that's not all. Countless fans have gathered outside the venue on their own, ready to give their all to cheer you on. It was worth planting all those people across fan communities. They really helped drum up momentum after Phantom Entertainment's statement.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I knew it... This concert means a lot to you, doesn't it, Eliza? You wouldn't have put in so much effort otherwise. Will you really not tell me still? Even though the concert's about to start?

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Do you really need to know?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Of course! This was never just Phanuel's goal alone, but something that we would accomplish together! That's been the case ever since Eliza took me in, trained me, and gave me the name Phanuel!

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I still remember the first time we met. You asked me if I wanted to make a big splash in Eastside together. Back then, I never could have imagined we'd come this far.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: You never told me, but I know you have ambitions. You have your own agenda. And now, I want to carry Eliza's true wish with me as I step onto this stage we built together.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Our stage? I like the sound of that. But you don't need to worry about my problems. As long as you can leave your mark in this pathetic little city, that's all the vindication I need.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Every bit of fame and recognition I never got as a young model—you will reclaim it all for me, one by one.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Those same tactics made me despised by countless people and forced me out of the industry. Yet now, they have become the perfect weapon to keep you in the spotlight — to turn you into someone your fans can’t live without. You should be grateful that I found you at the right time.

Eliza fusses over Phanuel's outfit, straightening clothes that are already perfectly in order. In the mirror, Phanuel catches something genuine flickering across Eliza's usually cold face. Something like... the thrill of exacting vengeance.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: There. Beautiful, as expected of the angel I handpicked. Don't second-guess yourself. We're one step away from the finish line. I'll be right there in the crowd, watching us succeed.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I see. So that's what Eliza has always wanted.
As Phanuel stares at her own reflection, she can't help but feel how different she and Eliza look. Yet she can't put her finger on why.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Stop daydreaming. Just five minutes left. Go stand by in the wings.
Phanuel takes a deep breath and puts that perfect smile of hers back on.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Okay. I'm ready.
Eliza is already waiting in the hallway outside the dressing room.
At the far end of the corridor, the stage lift's lights glow like a giant eye, waiting to swallow her whole.
[Outside the Concert Hall - Service Corridor]

Every major entrance to the venue has been filled to the brim with fans, all hoping to catch a glimpse of Phanuel. Luckily, the equipment cases around the back door serve as good cover, so you and your team manage to slip in without issue.

As soon as you step into the fire corridor leading backstage, you find Wynn and the rest of the support team. They moved inside the moment the fan gathering spiraled out of control, and have been waiting for you since.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Chief! I tried negotiating like you asked, but management refused to cooperate. They don't recognize our authority and are demanding a higher-level administrative order before they'll let us intervene.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Too many civilians are involved, after all. I wouldn't want to be held responsible for the fallout either, much less risk a stampede with thirty thousand people. The council's been playing hot potato with it too. By the time they reach a verdict, this whole ordeal would be long over.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: If you wish to seek assistance from Paradeisos, I can help you contact them.

options: Thanks, that's very thoughtful of you.

steps.content: The thought of the people behind certain numbers makes you roll your eyes.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: We're short on time. I'm not about to spend an hour in a meeting debating the value of human lives. I'm plenty grateful that FAC is willing to step in and help.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Most of the people here are ordinary civilians though. FAC can't afford to be too heavy-handed, or they'll risk triggering a Mania panic in Eastside. There's a limit to how much they can help.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: That's why we need to shut the concert down before Phanuel takes the stage. It all comes down to how well we work together now.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: The fact that we managed to meet up with you here, Chief, proves the teamwork is already there.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Sorry to interrupt again... I am aware this is not the ideal moment to dampen morale, but based on field reconnaissance data from the advance team, the current window of opportunity is not generous.
Schorl's projection interface lights up on the wall. Several venue schematics flash into view in quick succession, revealing the pipeline routing, power nodes, and a heat map of personnel movement.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The venue has a large number of staff, with Mirrormoon's core personnel concentrated in two main areas: the master control room behind the stage, and the equipment server room on the east side of the venue.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Based on equipment labels and personnel access levels, we'll most likely find the central signal hub for the glow sticks in the latter.

The two areas are kept separate for emergency isolation purposes. Should either end experience an anomaly, the other can continue operating independently. Accordingly, this also makes coordinating your next moves far more difficult.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Based on current M-values, the Mania concentration among Phanuel's fans has reached the critical threshold for the Hollow Syndrome, driven by the emotional climate. We also know that the glow sticks can directly interact with the Mania energy field within range. The moment the signal is severed, all that Mania energy will undergo unpredictable fluctuations.

Right. The spread of Hollow Syndrome has always been relatively contained, leaving you with insufficient data to work from. Once the synchronization of the light sticks is broken, whether the excess psychic energy mutates or coalesces into something unknown, you can't say for sure.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Then moving into parallel would be our best option right now. We need to seize control of the stage and the glow stick hub at the same time. We'll also need another way to stabilize the M-values across the venue and keep the fans occupied.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Phanuel should be waiting in the wings by now... Since Eliza's noticed that something's off, she'll definitely be in the control room to make sure nothing goes wrong. In that case, I'll take the control center. Wynn, Eugene, I'll leave the equipment room to you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Schorl, keep our communications channel clear throughout. As for what happens after the glow stick hub goes down...
Your gaze shifts to the unfamiliar face that's been hiding behind Wynn this whole time.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: I'll do whatever you need! Just say the word!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Take it easy. Even if the Mania contamination does go out of control, we always have the shackles as a safety net. Just do what you can. That'll be enough.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Your friend will hear your voice. I promise.
[Venue Plaza]

steps.speaker: FAC
steps.content:
Emergency alert! Due to severe overcrowding of attendees, a crowd crush or stampede might occur at any moment!
All individuals without tickets must evacuate the premises immediately! Please follow security personnel's instructions and exit the venue!
FAC's loudspeakers repeat the evacuation notice over and over, but the chants and screams of the crowd devour every word.

steps.speaker: Fan A
steps.content: We just want to hear Phanuel's voice! We've done nothing wrong! Why are you driving us away?! I don't see you pointing your weapons at the elites when they throw galas mid-war!

steps.speaker: Fan B
steps.content: Danger?! More like you want to silence Phanuel! Is bullying a girl who loves the stage all you people are good for?!

Phantom Entertainment's perfectly timed inflammatory announcement had done its job, casting Phanuel as the victim in the eyes of an unsuspecting crowd. What began as raw emotion had escalated into a full-blown protest.

steps.speaker: Fan C
steps.content: I came all the way from the West District just for a chance to see Phanuel! What gives you the right to throw me out?! You just wait till I put you online!

A rock flies out from the crowd and strikes the helmet of an officer in the front lines. The FAC officer staggers back, in turn opening a gap, and the crowd instantly surges forward like sharks drawn to blood.

steps.speaker: Fan A
steps.content: Protect Phanuel! Down with the corruption!

steps.speaker: Fan B
steps.content: Don't be afraid, Phanuel! We've got your back! Your Cherubs will always be here for you!
Every voice converges into a single name. Wave after wave of pink light crashes against the FAC's defensive line.

steps.speaker: FAC
steps.content: This is for everyone's safety. Please comply with our instructions—
But the words fall on deaf ears. The tide of people continues to push against the very armor that exists to protect them.

steps.speaker: FAC
steps.content: Stand back! Stop pushing! This is your final warning!

steps.speaker: Fan A
steps.content: Keep going, everyone! They won't actually do anything! Push!
Bang!!!
A deafening shot rings out as smoke grenades detonate in the crowd. The rioting fans freeze in their tracks. The plaza grows silent in an instant.

steps.speaker: FAC
steps.content: The area is now under lockdown. All individuals are to remain in place and evacuate in an orderly fashion. Anyone who fails to comply will be charged with endangering public safety.
The FAC has regained control of the situation. Before the smoke clears, a lone figure slips into the gaps between the crowd.
[Stage]
Phanuel stands beneath the lifting platform. The crew members are running final checks on her microphone and equipment.

Looking up from where she stands, the opening above looks just like a little skylight. The edges are lined with metal frames and track grooves, the lights scattered across the dark arched ceiling appearing just like glittering stars.
She cannot see the audience. Even after countless rehearsals, she still cannot picture what it looks like to have a stadium filled with people who came just for her.
Phanuel's earpiece is live. Through it, she can hear every department hard at work. Sound, ready. Wardrobe and makeup, standing by. Lighting, calibrated.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Looks like everyone has something they want to do for themselves...
One by one, the crew members step back, clearing the space around the platform for Phanuel.
She stares at the pitch-black ceiling, yet what appears before her is an entirely different sky.

It is vast and blue. Beneath it are streams of traffic and swaying tree shadows. The melting ice cream slowly drips down the sides of its box, carrying that cheap artificial sweetness she'd never tasted before. The corner of her mouth curves up, ever so slightly.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: ...Ice cream.
She murmurs it softly, as if savoring that unfamiliar word for the first time.
[Flashback: Unbinding Chief at the Depot]
She hesitates for a long moment before handing over Eliza's key.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: You've asked me so many questions. Can I ask you one?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: You came looking for me because of the Hollow Syndrome from the very start, right?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Can I know why you're so determined to see this through? Why do you want to help those victims so much? To the point where you'd let yourself be dragged all the way here?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: And... how do you know why you're doing all this?
Freedom. The taste of summer. The open sky. The humid, scorched streets. These things have branded themselves into her skin, impossible to ignore, impossible to heal from.
The person before her takes some time to ponder the question, then answers with the same steadiness as always.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I never really think about these things before I act. But if I had to say... I do it for the people I have to protect, the truth I have to uncover, and the responsibility that comes with my power.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Where the meaning comes from matters less than you think. But that's not something I can teach you in a moment. It takes a lot of living outside the spotlight to understand.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I see. Looks like this question's a bit too hard for you too...
[Exit flashback]
Bang! The lights above suddenly blaze to life. Pulsing pink beams cut through the narrow opening of the lifting platform.
The restless crowd outside ignites in an instant. What follows is a deafening roar. Phanuel knows. It's time.
The big screens begin rolling footage of her past performances. From Love & Chocolate, her song that went viral the moment she debuted, to her most recent and controversial concert premiere...

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Come on, Phanuel, you need to get those wicked thoughts out now. What if he doesn't even show up?
steps.female_content: Come on, Phanuel, you need to get those wicked thoughts out now. What if she doesn't even show up?

steps.speaker: Fans (in unison)
steps.content: "Ten!" "Nine!" "Eight!"

The countless voices crash in from every direction, pouring through panels and steel frames, flooding that small pocket of space beneath the platform. Those are the frenzy and devotion of fans from every corner of DisCity.

steps.speaker: Fans (in unison)
steps.content: "Seven!" "Six!"
Phanuel can hear her own heartbeat. She closes her eyes, adjusts her earpiece, and takes a deep breath.

steps.speaker: Fans (in unison)
steps.content: "Five!" "Four!"
Tracy is sitting in the front row of Section A, all dressed up. Her face is carefully done, light stick held to her chest, counting down with reverence like everyone else.

steps.speaker: Fans (in unison)
steps.content: "Three!"

steps.speaker: Fans (in unison)
steps.content: "Two!"

steps.speaker: Fans (in unison)
steps.content: "One!"
[Design a grand entrance for Joan, keep playing Joan's guitar]
Good evening, Eastside. I'm your special guest for tonight—
A piercing guitar riff tears through the air.

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: Not that I was invited. Guess that means I'm just here to crash the party!
Her voice reaches all the way backstage. The Bureau team, who were getting ready for their operation there, freeze in place.
The venue's security team is the first to react. They lunge forward to intercept, only to find a silver gun barrel leveled at their faces.
The gun's owner doesn't spare them so much as a glance, eyes locked on the uninvited guest up on stage.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Found you.
